decisions.notes: A school desk with a wood top, storage shelf and metal legs; all twelve exterior, clay and wireframe views inspected. The silhouette is intact in the supplied renders.
limitations: The geometry report found three zero-area triangles; no visible effect was apparent in the inspection renders.
The shelf interior is visible from the back, but no interactive adjustment was tested.
The distributed texture maps are 2K; higher-resolution upstream files are not included.
glTF validator reports 1 generated-tangent-space warning(s); normal-map shading can vary by renderer.

decisions.notes: Modular weathered wooden pier pieces, including planks, posts and an arch; all twelve rendered views show a partial example and separate components.
limitations: This is a modular parts scene with loose pieces, not a single finished watertight pier. Assembly, collisions and navigation have not been tested.
The distributed texture maps are 1K; higher-resolution upstream files are not included.
glTF validator reports 12 generated-tangent-space warning(s); normal-map shading can vary by renderer.

decisions.notes: A set of fire-escape platforms, ladders and railings arranged separately; all twelve rendered inspection views and technical reports reviewed.
limitations: Parts are displayed separately rather than as an assembled escape. Fit, attachment, collisions and navigation have not been tested.
